faqs: How do I choose a water testing company in Pakistan?

Decide what the report is for, check that the parameters you need are within the laboratory's PNAC scope at the testing site, confirm EPA certification for regulatory work, ask who samples and how chain of custody is kept, compare quotes parameter by parameter, and look at a sample report before ordering.
What is the difference between an accredited and a certified laboratory?

Accreditation (ISO/IEC 17025, granted by PNAC) is an assessment of technical competence for specific tests. Certification by Sindh EPA or Punjab EPA is the provincial agency's approval to produce monitoring data for its submissions. Regulatory work usually needs both; ISO 9001 certification is neither.
Is the cheapest water test good enough?

Sometimes. For a quick check of TDS and hardness on a borewell, a basic panel is fine. For anything a regulator, buyer or bank will read, the method, the accreditation scope and the sampling record decide whether the report is accepted, and those are what cheaper quotes usually leave out.
Should the laboratory take the sample?

For regulatory, audit and legal purposes, yes. Sampling by the laboratory's field team, recorded on a chain-of-custody form, is what makes the result defensible. For a household check, careful self-sampling in the laboratory's bottles is acceptable.
How can I check a test report is genuine?

Use the laboratory's verification route. Envi Tech AL reports are checked on the report verification portal using the report number and date. A report that cannot be verified independently should not be relied on.
Does the laboratory need to be in my city?

Only for microbiology and other short holding-time parameters, which need a same-day or overnight route or a field visit. Chemistry and metals travel for days when preserved and cooled, so a laboratory in Karachi or Lahore can serve any city in Pakistan by courier.

posts.title: EPA Certified Laboratories in Pakistan: Sindh EPA, Punjab EPA and PNAC Explained

posts.description: What EPA certified laboratory means in Sindh and Punjab, where each agency publishes its list, how it differs from PNAC accreditation, and how to verify a lab.
posts.excerpt: EPA certification is provincial, time-limited and sometimes partial. How Sindh EPA and Punjab EPD certify laboratories, where the lists are, and why PNAC accreditation is a separate check.
posts.author: imran
posts.image_alt: EPA certified laboratories in Pakistan: Sindh EPA, Punjab EPA and PNAC explained
faqs: What is an EPA certified laboratory in Pakistan?

A laboratory certified by a provincial Environmental Protection Agency to test samples and produce monitoring data for that agency's purposes. In Sindh the certificate is issued under the Sindh Environmental Quality Standards (Certification of Environmental Laboratories) Regulations 2014; in Punjab the Environment Protection Department issues a Certificate of Approval and lists certified laboratories on its website.
Where is the list of EPA certified labs?

Punjab publishes it on the EPD website under Resource Centre, EPA Certified Laboratories, with each certificate as a PDF. Sindh EPA notifies certified laboratories in the official Gazette and publishes its list through the agency; ask the laboratory for its certificate if you cannot find the current list.
How long is Sindh EPA laboratory certification valid?
Two years from the date of the certificate, unless suspended or revoked earlier. The certificate stays valid while a renewal application is being decided.
Is a PNAC accredited lab automatically EPA certified?
No. They are separate recognitions from separate bodies. A laboratory applies for each one, and a regulatory submission normally needs the EPA certificate for the relevant province.
Can a laboratory be certified for some parameters only?
Yes. The Sindh regulations allow the agency to accept an application partially for certain purposes or parameters only, so check the certificate's scope, not just the laboratory's name on the list.
Which certificates does Envi Tech AL hold?

The Karachi laboratory holds Sindh EPA certification and PNAC accreditation LAB-285. The Lahore laboratory holds a Punjab EPD Certificate of Approval (2025 to 2028) and PNAC accreditation LAB-347. Each applies to its own site and published scope.
Does a Sindh certificate work for a facility in Punjab?
Not for Punjab EPA submissions. Certification is provincial, which is why a laboratory serving both provinces needs a certificate from each agency.

faqs: How much does water testing cost in Lahore?

It depends on the parameter panel, the methods, whether results must be within an accredited scope, whether the laboratory samples on site, and the reporting purpose. A basic household panel and a full PEQS drinking water panel with metals and microbiology are different products at different prices. Ask for a written scope and compare quotations parameter by parameter.
Is there a water testing laboratory price list for Lahore?

Laboratories price per parameter and per service, so a meaningful quotation is built from your source, purpose and parameter list rather than read from a flat list. Envi Tech AL provides a written scope and quotation on request, usually the same working day.
Which parameters should a Lahore borewell test include?

pH, TDS, hardness, chloride, sulphate, nitrate, fluoride, arsenic, iron, and total coliform with E. coli. Arsenic and fluoride are the groundwater parameters in Punjab most likely to exceed PEQS without affecting taste.
Can I send a sample from Rawalpindi or Islamabad?

Yes. Chemistry and metals travel by overnight courier in the bottles the laboratory supplies. Microbiology must arrive within 24 hours of sampling, which an overnight courier usually meets; otherwise a field visit is arranged.
Does the price include sampling?

Sampling and collection are quoted as their own line, so you can see what you are paying for. For Punjab EPA submissions and audits, sampling by the laboratory's team with chain of custody is the right choice; for a household check, self-sampling in the laboratory's bottles is acceptable.
Will the report be accepted by Punjab EPA?

Envi Tech AL's Lahore laboratory is listed as a certified environmental laboratory by the Punjab EPD and holds PNAC accreditation LAB-347. Reports state the method, limit and accreditation status for each parameter, which is what the agency reviews. Acceptance of a submission depends on the results and the rest of the file.
How long does a water test take in Lahore?
It depends on the panel. Microbiology needs incubation time and some metals run in batches. The laboratory gives a reporting date at booking.
